events.name: Bash
events.head: List Dodo env var names and related scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -o '^DODO[A-Z_]*' app/.env.local; echo ---; grep -rn "DODO_[A-Z_]*" cloud/src --include=*.ts -o | sort -u | head -20; echo ---; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E 'probe-workshop|dodo|sign'; ls cloud/scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -i dodo; echo ---; grep -n "hooks/dodo" -r cloud/src | head -5
